# ClsColor

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Drawing](BlitzBasic-Drawing)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ClsColor:Void red:Int32, green:Int32, blue:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | In | Int32 | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | In | Int32 | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | In | Int32 | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

## Description

Sets the color that [Cls](Cls) clears with. It does not change the drawing color of [Color](Color). Values are clamped to 0 through 255.

## Related Commands

[Cls](Cls), [Color](Color), [ColorBlue](ColorBlue), [ColorGreen](ColorGreen), [ColorRed](ColorRed), [GetColor](GetColor)
